caption: 01 · CAPACITY — What burden leaves the founder?. Name the decisions, relationships, records, calendars, risks, and emotional labor the partner carries. Replace “business side” with observable work and consequences.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

caption: 02 · AUTHORITY — What may each person decide?. Write decision rights as verb plus object, threshold, required consultation, override, evidence, and appeal. Separate custom from enforceable authority.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping what may each person decide? within The Business Partner Beside the Name.
rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

caption: 03 · ECONOMICS — How are value and downside shared?. Map equity, votes, salary, royalty, bonus, expenses, guarantees, vesting, transfer, dilution, information, and exit separately. Public filings are examples, not templates.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
